terms.gloss: a vending machine; at a station, the ticket machine
evidence: M-O s.v. vending machine: māchina vēnditōria, māchina cibōs vēndendī
terms.comment: Morgan–Owens’s word for a vending machine, which is what a ticket machine is; where the tickets need saying, add them (māchina tesserārum vēnditōria, ours). māchina is classical, any contrivance or engine; vēnditōrius is not in Lewis & Short, and its long ē follows the house’s vēndō.

phrases.english: We’ll buy the tickets from the machine.
Tap the ticket on the reader.

sources: Lewis & Short: machina · Lewis & Short: venditor
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. vending machine.
